subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should CodexBar support cookie refresh as a standalone CLI command, provider settings actions, or a narrower signed-app-only recovery flow for browser-cookie providers?
rationale: The branch itself documents that the CLI lacks the entitlement needed for direct browser import, while it also introduces settings-pane actions; selecting the permanent user contract is a product and supportability choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Narrow to signed-app recovery
options.body: Keep a provider settings action or an app-mediated CLI handoff that can actually import browser cookies, and document the exact supported providers.

options.title: Support both surfaces
options.body: Approve both CLI and settings actions only after defining consistent semantics, success/failure output, and upgrade-safe support expectations for each.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the existing cache-clear workflow until a broader cookie-provider refresh architecture is approved.

recommendation.title: Narrow to signed-app recovery
recommendation.body: Keep a provider settings action or an app-mediated CLI handoff that can actually import browser cookies, and document the exact supported providers.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision selects the user-facing CLI and provider-settings product surface.
